name: Daikaffil Chemicals India Limited
summary: Daikaffil Chemicals India Limited manufactures and trades in organic chemicals and intermediaries in India and internationally. The company offers optical brighteners or fluorescent whitening agents used to make plastics, fibers, coatings, inks, and detergents, as well as uncoated fine paper; and naphthol, an organic compound used to manufacture organic pigments/master batch used for colouring paint, ink, plastic, fabric, cosmetics, food, and other materials. It also provides sulfonic and disulfonic acid; and dye intermediates to manufacture direct dyes, acid dyes, reactive dyes, food colours, pigments, drugs, etc., as well as intermediates for dyestuffs and pharmaceuticals. Daikaffil Chemicals India Limited was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Mumbai, India.
